verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents several automation features that act across many emails at once — Auto Archive and Auto Labels classify/archive marketing and low-priority messages in bulk (superhuman-docs-3, superhuman-docs-16, superhuman-docs-27), split-inbox lets users process same-type emails together (superhuman-docs-17), and the MCP-connected agent can check read status, draft all nudges, and send follow-ups across the inbox 'with one prompt' (superhuman-docs-25, superhuman-docs-31). However, there's no explicit documentation of a user-invoked bulk-select/bulk-action command (e.g., archiving or replying to N selected items at once) beyond these automated background rules and agent-driven workflows. Missing for 10: explicit multi-select bulk action UI/API, quantified scale limits, and independent hands-on confirmation that bulk operations work reliably at volume.
